integrity: The proof derives the false-twin support partition and disjointness quotient directly, proves the quotient automorphism action from singleton neighborhoods, and establishes both directions of the determining-set characterization. A standalone standard-library checker exhaustively reconstructs graph automorphisms and minimum determining sets in four small boundary cases and separately checks the closed formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers finite reduced commutative nonfield rings \(R=\prod_i\mathbb F_{q_i}\).
Nilpotent local factors are outside scope because support fibers can split into finer radical layers.
The fully Boolean case gives an exact separating-family characterization and minimum size, but no count of all minimum separating families.
The later automorphism-group article was inspected through its public abstract rather than full text; no novelty is claimed for the automorphism-group structure used in the proof.
title: Determining sets of reduced comaximal graphs: a Boolean phase transition
